## Summary

Explain user-visible value and scope.

## Validation

List commands run and results. Recommended baseline:

```text
make check
```

## Provenance and safety

- [ ] Changes are original or include compatible attribution and licensing.
- [ ] No supervisor-provided workbook, private manuscript, restricted dataset, or copied phrasebank content is included.
- [ ] New phrase patterns declare `original_editorial` provenance and `source_reuse: false`.
- [ ] Scientific claim strength, causal status, citations, quantities, and uncertainty remain evidence-calibrated.
- [ ] Tests cover behavioral or data-contract changes.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated when users need them.
- [ ] Breaking changes and migration steps are stated below, or this change is backward compatible.

## Breaking changes

Write `None` or explain impact and migration.
